title: BlindMenu
description: A mod that allows you to apply the effect of blindness and darkness on yourself
body:
Pressing **G** opens a menu where you can apply the **Blindness** and **Darkness** effect on yourself. This can be useful, for example, for playing with friends or just for an unusual experience.

![Menu looks like:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bca2762f08e8f4c4d0dce14b1320ac44f35fdb67.png)

Version: Forge 1.20.1
